name: navigate
title: Navigate
description: Navigate a tab to a URL (defaults to the active tab). Only web URLs can be opened: http://, https://, about:blank and data:. Other schemes (file:, chrome:, view-source:, javascript:, app links) and URLs without a scheme fail with URL_SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED; pass a full https:// URL instead. The operator may maintain a URL blocklist; a blocked target fails with URL_BLOCKED and must not be retried. A URL that answers with a download (Content-Disposition: attachment) saves the file into the managed downloads dir (<data-dir>/sessions/<id>/downloads/) within the same timeout: the tab keeps its page, status is null, and download holds saved_to, suggested_name and size, as download_file returns them. A download that fails or runs out of time is DOWNLOAD_FAILED.
